_source: CAQH Roster Individual API Specification v2.0, Appendix A.2, Table 38: Provider Status (pages 33-34)
_field: Returned in response as `provider.status` (Character 30). This is the practitioner's lifecycle status in the Provider Data Portal — distinct from `roster_status` (which is the plan's roster membership) and `authorization_flag` (which is whether the practitioner has authorized the plan to view data).

values.description: Provider Status was Initial Outreach and the practitioner changed their primary email at registration, OR the Welcome email bounced back and a new email address was used.
Practitioner's primary practice state is NOT IL and they have not attested in the last 120 days; OR primary practice state IS IL and they have not attested in the last 180 days.
New practitioner has registered and logged into the Provider Data Portal with username/password, OR a new practitioner contacts the Help Desk.
When the system sends a Welcome Email, OR when CAQH Operations sends a Welcome Letter through USPS. (Note: USPS no longer used as of 06/08/2020.)
Practitioner has attested for the first time and all required documents approved.
Practitioner has confirmed to CAQH Operations that they no longer wish to participate in the Provider Data Portal.
Practitioner has attested for the first time and all required documents NOT approved.
Practitioner confirmed by CAQH Operations as deceased.
Practitioner confirmed by CAQH Operations as retired.
Practitioner's attestation after their first attestation.

When the CAQH Welcome Letter to a Practitioner is returned by USPS as Return to Sender due to bad mailing address, and no alternate email or mailing addresses are available. (USPS no longer used as of 06/08/2020.)
When the CAQH Welcome Letter is returned as Undeliverable due to bad address and no alternate email or mailing addresses are available. (USPS no longer used as of 06/08/2020.)
